description: SparkFun IoT RedBoard - ESP32-P4 (WiFi BLE): Arduino R3 form factor, ESP32-P4 rev 3, 16 MB flash, 32 MB PSRAM, ESP32-C5 co-processor for WiFi 6 and BLE (ESP-Hosted over SDIO), native USB
idf_dependencies_note: Exactly the versions Arduino-ESP32 3.3.11's P4 libraries were built with (tools/esp32p4-libs/3.3.11/versions.txt): its hosted glue (esp32-hal-hosted.c) is written for them. Change together with core_version.
